# Load Libraries
```{r LOAD LIBRARIES, include=FALSE}
#Cargamos las librerías necesarias para el análisis.
#library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggsci)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(ggrepel)

getwd()

private_map_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
repeat {
  private_map_file <- file.path(private_map_root, "metadata", "MURANUCI_sample_id_map.csv")
  if (file.exists(private_map_file)) break
  parent_dir <- dirname(private_map_root)
  if (identical(parent_dir, private_map_root)) {
    stop("Required private sample mapping not found: metadata/MURANUCI_sample_id_map.csv")
  }
  private_map_root <- parent_dir
}

private_sample_map <- read_csv(private_map_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

source("./import_kraken.R")
source("./functions_taxonomy_plots.R")
```

# TAXONOMY ANNOTATION: TAXPROFILER

En la siguiente tabla se muestra el informe de salida generado por Kraken2, que incluye las siguientes columnas:

1. Prop: Percentage of reads covered by the clade rooted at this taxon
2. Reads: Number of reads covered by the clade rooted at this taxon
3. Assigned: Number of reads assigned directly to this taxon
4. TaxRank: A rank code, indicating (U)nclassified, (D)omain, (K)ingdom, (P)hylum, (C)lass, (O)rder, (F)amily, (G)enus, or (S)pecies. All other ranks are simply '-'.
5. NCBI: NCBI taxonomy ID
6. Name: indented scientific name

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
#Cargar en una única tabla todos los report de bracken
    files = dir("../bracken/db2/",pattern = ".report_bracken_species.txt", full.names = T)
    tabla_raw <- import_kraken(files,threads = 20)
    #tabla_raw2 <- import_kraken2(files,threads = 20)
    
#Arreglar nombres en tabla    
    tabla <- tabla_raw %>% 
      mutate(Sample = gsub("_pe_run1_db2.bracken.kraken2.report_bracken_species.txt","",Sample))
    

    tabla <- tabla  %>% 
      mutate(Sample = coalesce(
        private_sample_map$name[match(Sample, private_sample_map$source_sample_id)],
        Sample
      )) %>%
      separate(Sample, c("Patient","Week"), sep="-0", remove=F) %>% 
      mutate(Week = str_replace(Week, "-M","")) %>%
      mutate(Week = as.integer(Week) -1) %>%
      mutate(Week = replace_na(Week, 0))

#Quitar controles
    controls_list <- c("Community-2", "COMUNITY-1", "CONTROL-DNA-2", "DNA-CONTROL-1", "Gut-1", "Gut-microbiome-2")
    tabla <- tabla %>% filter(!Sample %in% controls_list) 
    

abundance_matrix <- tabla %>% 
  dplyr::select(NCBI,Reads,Sample) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("NCBI")

DT::datatable(tabla[1:6])
```

# Cambiar asignación IDs de muestras
```{r}
# Tabla de correspondencia para IDs del paper

# Private correspondence file is stored outside the public results directory.

sample_id_newnames <- private_sample_map %>%
  transmute(
    Patient_old = sample,
    Week = as.integer(follow_up_week),
    patient_id,
    follow_up_week = paste0("W", follow_up_week)
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(sample_id_newnames[c("Patient_old", "Week")]),
  all(sample_id_newnames$Week %in% 0:2)
)

tabla <- tabla %>%
  rename(
    Patient_old = Patient
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_id_newnames,
    by = c("Patient_old", "Week")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Patient = patient_id,
      Patient = factor(Patient, levels = paste0("PAC", 1:8)),
    follow_up_week = factor(follow_up_week, levels = c("W0", "W1", "W2")),
    sample_plot_label = paste0(patient_id, " ", follow_up_week),
    sample_plot_label_2lines = paste0(patient_id, "\n", follow_up_week)
  )

```

## DOMAIN
**Proporción de OTUs nivel de Dominio y No clasificadas:**
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
#unclassified and kingdom
taxrank_domain <- tabla %>% 
  filter(TaxRank %in% c("U", "D")) %>% 
  rename(Domain = Name2) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_plot_label_2lines, y = Reads, fill = Domain)) + 
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black", width = 0.8) +  # Black borders and thinner bars
  scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20") +
  #scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +  # Improved color palette
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  labs(
    title = "Taxonomic Composition by Sample at Domain level",
    subtitle = "Proportion of normalized reads",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Relative abundance (%)",
    fill = "Domain"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),  # Rotates labels if there are many samples
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5)
  )
taxrank_domain

#ggsave(filename = "Taxonomic_Profile_D.svg", plot = taxrank_domain, device = "svg", path = "./PLOTS_TAX_AUTOGENERATED/", width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)

ggsave(filename = "Taxonomic_Profile_D.png", plot = taxrank_domain, device = "png", path = "./PLOTS_TAX_AUTOGENERATED/", width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
El gráfico muestra, para cada muestra, la abundancia relativa de lecturas normalizadas a nivel de dominio mediante barras apiladas al 100%, incluyendo la fracción no clasificada. Esto permite comparar entre muestras la proporción de cada dominio y el porcentaje de lecturas sin asignación taxonómica.

Los análisis y visualizaciones posteriores incluyen únicamente las entidades clasificadas dentro del **dominio Bacteria**.

### Reads + No Free Y
```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
# 0) Mapping 1:1 de Sample -> Patient/Week (si no es 1:1, lo verás aquí)
mapping <- tabla %>%
  select(Sample, Patient, follow_up_week) %>%
  distinct()

# (Opcional) check rápido: si devuelve filas, tienes samples con >1 Patient/Week
# mapping %>% count(Sample) %>% filter(n > 1)

taxrank_pathogens <- tabla %>%
  filter(grepl("Bacteria", Fullname)) %>%
  filter(
    (TaxRank == "S"  & Name2 == "Acinetobacter baumannii") |
    (TaxRank == "S"  & Name2 == "Escherichia coli") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Citrobacter") |
    (TaxRank == "S"  & Name2 == "Klebsiella pneumoniae") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Proteus") |
    (TaxRank == "S"  & Name2 == "Pseudomonas aeruginosa") |
    (TaxRank == "G1" & Name2 == "Enterobacter cloacae complex") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Serratia") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Salmonella") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Shigella") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Staphylococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Enterococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Streptococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Burkholderia") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Stenotrophomonas")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Pathogens = case_when(
    Name2 %in% c("Burkholderia", "Stenotrophomonas") ~ "Other NFGNB",
    Name2 %in% c("Staphylococcus", "Enterococcus", "Streptococcus") ~ "Gram-positive bacteria",
    Name2 %in% c("Serratia", "Salmonella", "Shigella") ~ "Other Enterobacterales",
    TRUE ~ Name2
  )) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Patient, follow_up_week, Pathogens) %>%
  summarise(Sum = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sort(unique(Sample))),
    Pathogens = factor(
      Pathogens,
      levels = c(
        sort(setdiff(unique(Pathogens), c("Other NFGNB", "Gram-positive bacteria", "Other Enterobacterales"))),
        "Other NFGNB", "Gram-positive bacteria", "Other Enterobacterales"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = follow_up_week, y = Sum, fill = Pathogens)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20", labels = taxon_plotmath_labels) +
  scale_reads_millions +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  labs(
    title = "Taxonomic Composition by Sample",
    subtitle = "Clinically relevant bacterial taxa",
    x = "Follow-up week",
    y = "Bracken-estimated reads (millions)",
    fill = "Pathogen"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Patient)

taxrank_pathogens

ggsave(filename = "Taxonomic_Profile_Pathogens_readsAbundance_sameYaxis.png", plot = taxrank_pathogens, device = "png", path = "./PLOTS_TAX_AUTOGENERATED/", width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
    Name2 %in% c("Burkholderia", "Stenotrophomonas") ~ "Other NFGNB",
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
taxrank_pathogens_df <- tabla %>%
  filter(grepl("Bacteria", Fullname)) %>%
  filter(
    (TaxRank == "S" & Name2 == "Acinetobacter baumannii") |
    (TaxRank == "S" & Name2 == "Escherichia coli") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Citrobacter") |
    (TaxRank == "S" & Name2 == "Klebsiella pneumoniae") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Proteus") |
    (TaxRank == "S" & Name2 == "Pseudomonas aeruginosa") |
    (TaxRank == "G1" & Name2 == "Enterobacter cloacae complex") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Serratia") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Salmonella") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Shigella") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Staphylococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Enterococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Streptococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Burkholderia") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Stenotrophomonas")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Name2 %in% c("Burkholderia", "Stenotrophomonas") ~ "Other NFGNB",
      Name2 %in% c("Staphylococcus", "Enterococcus", "Streptococcus") ~ "Gram-positive bacteria",
      Name2 %in% c("Serratia", "Salmonella", "Shigella") ~ "Other Enterobacterales",
      TRUE ~ Name2
    ),
    Taxa = Name2
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Patient, follow_up_week, Group, Taxa) %>%
  summarise(Sum = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sort(unique(Sample)))
  )

  "Acinetobacter baumannii",

  "Escherichia coli",
  "Klebsiella pneumoniae",
  "Proteus",
  "Pseudomonas aeruginosa",
  "Enterobacter cloacae complex",
  "Burkholderia",
  "Stenotrophomonas",
  "Staphylococcus",
  "Enterococcus",
  "Streptococcus",
  "Serratia",
  "Salmonella",
  "Shigella"
)

taxrank_pathogens_df <- taxrank_pathogens_df %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels),
    Taxa = factor(Taxa, levels = taxa_levels),
    Label_taxa = case_when(
      Group %in% c("Other NFGNB", "Gram-positive bacteria", "Other Enterobacterales") ~ as.character(Taxa),
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample, follow_up_week, Group, Taxa)

taxrank_pathogens <- ggplot(
  taxrank_pathogens_df,
  aes(
    x = factor(follow_up_week),
    y = Sum,
    fill = Group,
    order = Taxa
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    aes(group = interaction(Group, Taxa)),
    color = "black",
    width = 0.8
  ) +
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
  filter(grepl("Bacteria", Fullname)) %>%
  filter(
    (TaxRank == "S" & Name2 == "Acinetobacter baumannii") |
    (TaxRank == "S" & Name2 == "Escherichia coli") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Citrobacter") |
    (TaxRank == "S" & Name2 == "Klebsiella pneumoniae") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Proteus") |
    (TaxRank == "S" & Name2 == "Pseudomonas aeruginosa") |
    (TaxRank == "G1" & Name2 == "Enterobacter cloacae complex") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Serratia") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Salmonella") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Shigella") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Staphylococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Enterococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Streptococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Burkholderia") |
    (TaxRank == "G" & Name2 == "Stenotrophomonas")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Name2 %in% c("Burkholderia", "Stenotrophomonas") ~ "Other NFGNB",
      Name2 %in% c("Staphylococcus", "Enterococcus", "Streptococcus") ~ "Gram-positive bacteria",
      Name2 %in% c("Serratia", "Salmonella", "Shigella") ~ "Other Enterobacterales",
      TRUE ~ Name2
    ),
    Taxa = Name2
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Patient, follow_up_week, Group, Taxa) %>%
  summarise(Sum = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sort(unique(Sample)))
  )

# Orden de grupos
group_levels <- c(
  "Acinetobacter baumannii",
  "Citrobacter",
  "Escherichia coli",
  "Klebsiella pneumoniae",
  "Proteus",
  "Pseudomonas aeruginosa",
  "Enterobacter cloacae complex",
  "Other NFGNB",
  "Gram-positive bacteria",
  "Other Enterobacterales"
)

# Orden interno de taxones
taxa_levels <- c(
  "Acinetobacter baumannii",
  "Citrobacter",
  "Escherichia coli",
  "Klebsiella pneumoniae",
  "Proteus",
  "Pseudomonas aeruginosa",
  "Enterobacter cloacae complex",
  "Burkholderia",
  "Stenotrophomonas",
  "Staphylococcus",
  "Enterococcus",
  "Streptococcus",
  "Serratia",
  "Salmonella",
  "Shigella"
)

taxrank_pathogens_df <- taxrank_pathogens_df %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels),
    Taxa = factor(Taxa, levels = taxa_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Patient, Sample, follow_up_week, Group, Taxa)

# Calcular posición media de cada segmento para poner la etiqueta fuera
labels_df <- taxrank_pathogens_df %>%
  group_by(Patient, follow_up_week) %>%
  arrange(Group, Taxa, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(Sum),
    ymin = ymax - Sum,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% c("Other NFGNB", "Gram-positive bacteria", "Other Enterobacterales"),
    Sum > 0
  )

taxrank_pathogens <- ggplot(
  taxrank_pathogens_df,
  aes(
    x = factor(follow_up_week),
    y = Sum,
    fill = Group,
    order = Taxa
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    aes(group = interaction(Group, Taxa)),
    color = "black",
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = labels_df,
    aes(
      x = factor(follow_up_week),
      y = ymid,
      label = taxon_plotmath_strings(Taxa)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    direction = "y",
    nudge_x = 0.35,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3,
    segment.color = "black",
    segment.size = 0.4,
    box.padding = 0.2,
    point.padding = 0.1,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 123,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20", labels = taxon_plotmath_labels) +
  scale_reads_millions +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Taxonomic Composition by Sample",
    subtitle = "Clinically relevant bacterial taxa",
    x = "Follow-up week",
    y = "Reads",
    fill = "Pathogen"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 70, 5.5, 5.5)   # espacio para etiquetas fuera
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Patient, scales = "free_y")
```

#DATOS NUMÉRICOS
```{r}
family_global_summary <- tabla %>%
  filter(grepl("Bacteria", Fullname)) %>%
  filter(TaxRank == "F") %>%
  group_by(Name2) %>%
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    global_relative_abundance = total_reads / sum(total_reads),
    threshold_group = case_when(
      global_relative_abundance >= 0.10 ~ ">=10%",
      global_relative_abundance >= 0.005 ~ ">=0.5%",
      TRUE ~ "<0.5%"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(global_relative_abundance))

family_global_summary %>% filter(global_relative_abundance >= 0.005)
family_global_summary %>% filter(global_relative_abundance >= 0.10)

write_csv(family_global_summary, "family_global_summary.csv")

# Versión para el manuscrito: familias con abundancia global >=0.5 %.
# La abundancia se expresa como porcentaje y se conserva con dos decimales; en
# el texto de Resultados puede redondearse posteriormente a una cifra decimal.
family_global_summary_paper <- family_global_summary %>%
  filter(global_relative_abundance >= 0.005) %>%
  transmute(
    Family = Name2,
    `Pooled family-level reads` = total_reads,
    `Global relative abundance (%)` = round(
      global_relative_abundance * 100,
      digits = 2
    ),
    `Threshold group` = threshold_group
  )

write_csv(
  family_global_summary_paper,
  "family_global_summary_paper.csv"
)

family_per_sample_summary <- tabla %>%
  filter(grepl("Bacteria", Fullname)) %>%
  filter(TaxRank == "F") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(sample_total_reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = Reads / sample_total_reads) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Patient, follow_up_week) %>%
  slice_max(relative_abundance, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Patient, Week, desc(relative_abundance))

write_csv(family_per_sample_summary, "family_per_sample_top3.csv")

pathogens_summary <- tabla %>%
  filter(grepl("Bacteria", Fullname)) %>%
  filter(
    (TaxRank == "S"  & Name2 == "Acinetobacter baumannii") |
    (TaxRank == "S"  & Name2 == "Escherichia coli") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Citrobacter") |
    (TaxRank == "S"  & Name2 == "Klebsiella pneumoniae") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Proteus") |
    (TaxRank == "S"  & Name2 == "Pseudomonas aeruginosa") |
    (TaxRank == "G1" & Name2 == "Enterobacter cloacae complex") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Serratia") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Salmonella") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Shigella") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Staphylococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Enterococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Streptococcus") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Burkholderia") |
    (TaxRank == "G"  & Name2 == "Stenotrophomonas")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pathogen_group = case_when(
      Name2 %in% c("Burkholderia", "Stenotrophomonas") ~ "Other NFGNB",
      Name2 %in% c("Staphylococcus", "Enterococcus", "Streptococcus") ~ "Gram-positive bacteria",
      Name2 %in% c("Serratia", "Salmonella", "Shigella") ~ "Other Enterobacterales",
      TRUE ~ Name2
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Patient, Week, follow_up_week, Pathogen_group) %>%
  summarise(
    reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Patient, Week, follow_up_week) %>%
  mutate(
    total_pathogen_reads = sum(reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    relative_within_selected_pathogens = reads / total_pathogen_reads
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Patient, Week, desc(reads))

write_csv(pathogens_summary, "pathogens_summary.csv")
```


# Tabla de taxón clínico dominante
```{r}
# Total de reads bacterianas por muestra
bacterial_total_reads <- tabla %>%
  filter(TaxRank == "D", Name2 == "Bacteria") %>%
  select(
    name = Sample,
    sample = Patient,
    week = Week,
    total_bacterial_reads = Reads
  )

# Metadata para etiquetas de las figuras
sample_plot_metadata <- tabla %>%
  distinct(
    name = Sample,
    sample = Patient,
    week = Week,
    sample_plot_label,
    sample_plot_label_2lines
  )

# Añadir % del panel y % del total bacteriano
pathogens_summary_total <- pathogens_summary %>%
  rename(
    name = Sample,
    sample = Patient,
    week = Week
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    bacterial_total_reads,
    by = c("name", "sample", "week")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_plot_metadata,
    by = c("name", "sample", "week")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    relative_within_selected_pathogens_percent =
      relative_within_selected_pathogens * 100,
    
    relative_to_total_bacteria =
      reads / total_bacterial_reads,
    
    relative_to_total_bacteria_percent =
      relative_to_total_bacteria * 100
  )

# Taxón clínicamente relevante dominante por muestra
dominant_clinically_relevant_taxa <- pathogens_summary_total %>%
  group_by(name, sample, week) %>%
  slice_max(reads, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    name,
    sample,
    week,
    dominant_clinically_relevant_taxon = Pathogen_group,
    dominant_taxon_reads = reads,
    dominant_taxon_percent_within_panel =
      relative_within_selected_pathogens_percent,
    dominant_taxon_percent_total_bacteria =
      relative_to_total_bacteria_percent,
    total_selected_taxa_reads = total_pathogen_reads,
    total_bacterial_reads
  )
dominant_clinically_relevant_taxa
write_csv(dominant_clinically_relevant_taxa, "dominant_clinically_relevant_taxa.csv")





# TODOS los taxones clínicamente relevantes detectados por muestra
clinically_relevant_taxa_all <- pathogens_summary_total %>%
  filter(reads > 0) %>% 
  group_by(name, sample, week) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon_rank_within_panel = dense_rank(desc(reads)),
    is_dominant_clinically_relevant_taxon = taxon_rank_within_panel == 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    name,
    sample,
    week,
    clinically_relevant_taxon = Pathogen_group,
    taxon_reads = reads,
    taxon_percent_within_panel =
      relative_within_selected_pathogens_percent,
    taxon_percent_total_bacteria =
      relative_to_total_bacteria_percent,
    taxon_rank_within_panel,
    is_dominant_clinically_relevant_taxon,
    total_selected_taxa_reads = total_pathogen_reads,
    total_bacterial_reads
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, week, taxon_rank_within_panel)

clinically_relevant_taxa_all

write_csv(
  clinically_relevant_taxa_all,  "clinically_relevant_taxa_all.csv"
)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
    follow_up_week,
    sample_plot_label_2lines,
    Pathogen_group,
    relative_to_total_bacteria_percent,
    reads
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_label = sample_plot_label_2lines
  ) %>%
  complete(
    sample_label,
    Pathogen_group,
    fill = list(
      relative_to_total_bacteria_percent = 0,
      reads = 0
    )
  )

# Orden de muestras
sample_order <- pathogens_summary_total %>%
  distinct(sample, week, sample_plot_label_2lines) %>%
  arrange(sample, week) %>%
  pull(sample_plot_label_2lines)

# Posicion de la ultima visita de cada paciente. Se excluye el borde posterior
# al ultimo paciente porque no separa dos pacientes distintos.
patient_boundaries <- pathogens_summary_total %>%
  distinct(sample, week, sample_plot_label_2lines) %>%
  arrange(sample, week) %>%
  mutate(sample_position = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    xintercept = max(sample_position) + 0.5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(xintercept < length(sample_order) + 0.5)

clinically_relevant_taxa_heatmap_df <- clinically_relevant_taxa_heatmap_df %>%
  mutate(
    sample_label = factor(sample_label, levels = sample_order),
    # rev() hace que ggplot muestre la lista solicitada de arriba abajo.
    Pathogen_group = factor(
      Pathogen_group,
      levels = rev(clinical_taxa_order)
    )
  )

# Heatmap estilo paper, sin negro
clinical_taxa_heatmap <- ggplot(
  clinically_relevant_taxa_heatmap_df,
  aes(
    x = sample_label,
    y = Pathogen_group,
    fill = relative_to_total_bacteria_percent
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = taxon_plotmath_labels) +
  geom_vline(
    data = patient_boundaries,
    aes(xintercept = xintercept),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#4D4D4D",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = ifelse(relative_to_total_bacteria_percent >= 5,
                     round(relative_to_total_bacteria_percent, 1),
                     "")
    ),
    size = 3,
    color = "#4D4D4D"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#F7FBFA",  # casi blanco
      "#DDF0EA",
      "#B8E0D2",
      "#7FCDBB",
      "#41B6C4",
      "#2C7FB8"
    ),
    trans = "sqrt",
    name = "% total\nbacterial reads",
    breaks = c(0, 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 75),
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, max(clinically_relevant_taxa_heatmap_df$relative_to_total_bacteria_percent, na.rm = TRUE)),
    na.value = "#F5F5F5"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Clinically relevant taxa detected by metagenomics",
    subtitle = "Relative abundance as percentage of total bacterial reads",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Clinically relevant taxon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, color = "#4D4D4D"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#4D4D4D"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#4D4D4D"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "black"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#6B7280"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#4D4D4D"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#4D4D4D")
  )

clinical_taxa_heatmap

ggsave(
  filename = "clinical_taxa_percent_total_bacteria_heatmap_paper_soft.png",
  plot = clinical_taxa_heatmap,
  path = "./PLOTS_TAX_AUTOGENERATED/",
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```



# Añadir riqueza del panel clínico

```{r}
selected_taxa_richness <- pathogens_summary_total %>%
  filter(reads > 0) %>%
  group_by(name, sample, week) %>%
  summarise(
    n_clinically_relevant_taxa_detected = n_distinct(Pathogen_group),
    selected_taxa_total_reads = sum(reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    selected_taxa_percent_total_bacteria = 
      100 * selected_taxa_total_reads / first(total_bacterial_reads),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
selected_taxa_richness
write_csv(selected_taxa_richness, "selected_taxa_richness.csv")
```
